purpose: Track Heineken price-source research without inflating country counts or losing reject/hold reasons.

counting.note: The exact earlier 16-country Heineken AUTO list was not preserved in the repository or retrievable prior context. Canada is proven new relative to that baseline because the earlier Canada route was explicitly rejected as paid before the BC-government route was found. Other PASS rows remain valid sources but are not added to safe_minimum until overlap is reconciled.

status_definitions.baseline_known: Known member of the earlier AUTO baseline.
status_definitions.pass: Free or adequate free quota, automatable, regular Heineken evidenced, and public-app reuse/display basis acceptable.
status_definitions.hold: Promising but at least one required gate remains unresolved.
status_definitions.reject: Fails a required gate for this project.

sources.reject_reason: Third-party sharing/use restrictions conflict with public price-map redistribution.
Primary retailer price data is not offered for open API/redistribution according to the current operator.
Official API is technically accessible, but site-use terms are too restrictive for copying, storing and redistributing prices.
Website-material distribution is prohibited without ATVR consent.
Acceptable-use restrictions conflict with competitive price comparison and building a public price-history database from response data.
Storage/public-sharing restrictions conflict with daily persistence and public historical-price display.
Beer coverage is a generic fixed 2L light-beer basket item and does not reliably cover regular Heineken.
Selected product universe is too narrow; regular Heineken not verified.
Selected monitored-goods universe does not include verified Heineken/beer coverage.
Dataset scope is agricultural/major foods and does not provide regular Heineken store prices.

sources.source_name: Korea Consumer Agency 참가격 open price data
sources.reuse_basis: Current public data permits reuse without restriction.
sources.reject_reason: The current monitored beer products are domestic products such as Cass, Terra, Hite and Jeju Wit Ale; regular Heineken is not in the monitored product universe.

The consumer system is free and near-real-time, but official use terms do not provide a sufficiently clear basis for public third-party redistribution/price-history publication; the separate Curitiba open dataset did not contain verified Heineken coverage.
